request.text: A tiny translucent cell draws liquid inward, slowly dissolves and absorbs another cell: very soft swirling viscous water, fine wet granular fizz and a few microscopic bubbles, ending in a warm pearlescent exhale. Beautiful, delicate and nourishing, not disgusting. Quiet close-up texture, no big splash, suction horror or bass impact. No music. No voices, harsh transients or distortion. Quiet microscopic pond-game sound design.
